06549 Par`oh N@koh {par-o' nek-o'} 或 Par`oh N@kow {par-o' nek-o'}

源自埃及文; 陽性專有名詞 人名

欽定本 - Pharaohnecho 5; 5

法老-尼哥 
1) 猶大王約西亞時的埃及法老, 他和約西亞在米吉多爭戰並把約西亞殺了, 另立
   約雅敬為猶大王.(#王下 23:29-35;耶 46:2|)

06549 Par`oh N@koh {par-o' nek-o'} or Par`oh N@kow {par-o' nek-o'}

of Egyptian derivation;; n pr m

AV - Pharaohnecho 5; 5

Pharaoh-necho = "great house-he is smitten"
1) the Pharaoh of Egypt who fought king Josiah of Judah at Megiddo
   and killed him
